newsitem.title: USA: AutoBond says underwriter rumors hurt stock.
newsitem.headline: AutoBond says underwriter rumors hurt stock.

text.p: AutoBond Acceptance Corp said Thursday the recent decline in its stock may be related to issues regarding Boston Group LP, which managed the company's initial public offering in November 1996.

The Boston Group is a market maker for for AutoBond. AutoBond investor Relations Representative Brenda Eames said there has been market speculation about the Boston Group's financial condition "which may have caused the decline in AutoBond stock."
No one from Boston Group was available for comment.
AutoBond said that its stock price decline should not be attributed to the company's performance.
Despite the sudden decline in the stock price, there has been no fundamental change in AutoBond's business or in the financial condition of AutoBond, the company said.
The stock was at 4-9/16, down 1-7/16 in early afternoon trading Thursday.
